annotations.title: Hand in a slip or supplier invoice

description: Only when you hold the actual file bytes (e.g. read from disk in code): hand in a receipt, till slip, fuel slip or supplier invoice (PDF or photo, base64, max 10 MB). For a slip the user showed you in the chat use accounting_record_slip instead. It is read immediately and filed under Slips & Documents for the business to check and post — nothing is posted to the ledger by this tool. Returns what was read. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.
